headline: In ‘The Brink of War,’ a Return to an Era of Razor-Edge Diplomacy
context: A new film depicts the 1986 nuclear arms summit in Reykjavik, Iceland, between Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev, which both offered and dashed hopes of a dramatic breakthrough.
